sn11.12:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū etad avoca || || 3.
sn11.12:1.3: Sakko bhikkhave devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno Magho nāma māṇavo ahosi || tasmā Maghavā ti vuccati || || 4.
sn11.12:2.1: Sakko bhikkhave devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno pure pure dānam adāsi || tasmā Purindado ti vuccati || || 5.
sn11.12:3.1: Sakko bhikkhave devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno sakkaccam dānam adāsi || tasmā Sakko ti vuccati || || 6.
sn11.12:4.1: Sakko bhikkhave devānam indo pubbe manussabhūto samāno āvasatham adāsi || tasmā Vāsavo ti vuccati || || 7.
sn11.12:5.1: Sakko bhikkhave devānam indo sahassam pi atthānam muhuttena cinteti || tasmā Sahassakkho ti vuccati || || 8.
sn11.12:6.1: Sakkassa bhikkhave devānam indassa Sujā nāma asurakaññā pajāpatī ahosi || tasmā Sujampatīti vuccati || || 9.
sn11.12:7.1: Sakko bhikkhave devānam indo devānam Tāvatiṃsānam issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāresi || tasmā devānam indo ti vuccati || || 10.
sn11.12:8.1: Sakkassa bhikkhave devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā || || 11.
sn11.12:8.7: Yāvajīvaṃ vigatamalamacchereṇa cetasā agāram ajjhāvaseyyam muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato || ||
sn11.12:8.9: Yāvajīvam akodhano assaṃ || sa ce pi me kodho uppajjeyya khippam eva naṃ paṭivineyyan ti || || 12.
sn11.12:8.10: Sakkassa bhikkhave devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā ti || ||
